transcript.speaker: Presenter
transcript.text: Welcome to World Watch. Today we meet a volunteer from the Green Garden Project.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Thanks for having me. It's great to be here.

transcript.speaker: Presenter
transcript.text: Tell us, what is the Green Garden Project?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: It's a charity in our area. We turned an old wasteland into a garden for the community. Children play there now.

transcript.speaker: Presenter
transcript.text: How did you first get involved?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: A neighbor encouraged me to join. Before that, I didn't really know people here. Now I know everyone.

transcript.speaker: Presenter
transcript.text: So you got to know your community.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Exactly. We respect each other's rights, and everyone helps. It's a good cause.

transcript.speaker: Presenter
transcript.text: Why is a green space important for a city?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Pollution is a big problem in cities. Green spaces give us cleaner air. They're good for our health too.

transcript.speaker: Presenter
transcript.text: Does the project help with bigger problems?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Yes. Some families here live in poverty. The garden gives them fresh food. It helps with hunger and gives children an education about food.

transcript.speaker: Presenter
transcript.text: You mentioned teaching. How did you learn to grow vegetables?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: I taught myself! I made mistakes at first, but I didn't blame myself. You learn by trying.

transcript.speaker: Presenter
transcript.text: You're running a fundraising campaign now, right?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Yes. We want to buy more plants and equipment. A local company just donated a large sum of money.

transcript.speaker: Presenter
transcript.text: In a world full of conflict, this garden brings people together.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: That's true. Everyone is welcome in the garden.

transcript.speaker: Presenter
transcript.text: How can our listeners help?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Come and volunteer! You can donate too. Every small effort makes a difference.

transcript.speaker: Presenter
transcript.text: Thanks, Tom. The Green Garden Project — what a great story.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Thank you. The garden is open to everyone.
